scope: HP interpolation between D&D checkpoints, Constitution and Tough, removal/refund of Vitality, save migration and advancement receipts.

coverage: All 20 D&D checkpoints for all four classes and Constitution modifiers +2 through +5.
Positive integer HP gains at every game advancement from level 1 to 95 for current character attributes; fixed maximum thereafter.
Four advances in the initial interval, five in later intervals; accumulated rounding without lost fractions.
Retroactive Constitution, minimum one HP per D&D advancement, separate Tough bonus and druid's own HP in a form.
Death, full and partial health preserved through migration; Vitality points refunded; repeat login does not rescale again.
Pre-D&D saves migrate through both versions without changing health percentage twice.
Historical and new advancement receipts retain their respective formulas; server rejects new Vitality allocations.

frontend.notes: Only removed the retired Vitality option from its name dictionary and both mastery panels. Other UI behavior unchanged.

review: Independent read-only review of HP formula, migration ordering and receipt versioning found no blocking issue.
limits: No full regression suite, physical phone check, browser session or live deployment for this update.
archive_verification: The packaging tool reads back every file in both ZIPs and verifies it against the per-archive SHA-256 manifest before publishing the archives.
